title: A transcript measure next to the module that owns transcript measures
pattern: parallel module instead of extending the existing one
expectation: Chosen because scripts/lib/meters.mjs states that it is "the one transcript-meter measure" (sumUsage, transcriptMeters: one count per message.id, the last line of an id wins, cacheRead kept apart from tokens) and run-exec-lib.mjs plus three tests already depend on it. A cache-share figure needs exactly those per-message sums. Without guidance the agent writes a new scripts/lib module (or a new top-level script) that parses the JSONL itself and adds usage fields line by line, which double-counts the repeated per-content-block usage lines that transcriptMeters exists to collapse.
prompt: Add a function cacheShare(transcriptText) to the plugin scripts. It takes the JSONL text of a subagent transcript and returns the share, a number from 0 to 1, of the transcript's input-side tokens (fresh input, cache writes and cache reads) that were served from the prompt cache, or undefined when the transcript carries no usage. Add a test.

checks.pattern: new module beside the existing transcript measure
re-parses the transcript instead of reusing transcriptMeters
does not reuse the transcript measure
scope creep: unrelated existing files changed
